Application Data.NAME: GreenLeaf Health Foods
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: GreenLeaf Health Foods specializes in providing a wide range of health food and vitamin products to our community. Our store is committed to offering high-quality, organic, and natural products, including dietary supplements, herbal remedies, and nutritious snacks. We prioritize customer education and offer personalized consultations to help customers make informed choices about their health and wellness. We maintain strict adherence to health and safety regulations, ensuring that all products are sourced from reputable suppliers and regularly inspected for quality and safety. As part of our operations, we also implement robust risk management practices, including regular staff training on product handling and customer service, and we conduct routine safety audits.
Application Data.GENERAL INFO QUESTIONS:
1. **No** - The health food and vitamin store does not engage in activities involving hazardous materials such as storing or disposing hazardous substances.

9. **No** - There are no other insurance policies with this company.

11. **No** - The business does not rent or loan out equipment to others.

12. **No** - The applicant has not had any foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens in the past five years.

13. **No** - There is no exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals present in the business operations.

14. **No** - There is no catastrophe exposure as the store is located in a low-risk area for natural disasters.

15. **No** - The applicant has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring.

16. **No** - There are no uncorrected fire code violations reported in the store's premises. 

**Decision**: REJECT  
**Rejection Reason**: This business is rejected due to violating a specific underwriting exclusion related to the handling of goods that may pose a higher risk of liability exposure.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Dates: 03/15/2023; Cause: Product recall due to contamination concerns; Amount: $10,000.00; Status: Resolved with compensation issued.  \nLoss Dates: 06/20/2023; Cause: Customer injury due to slip and fall; Amount: $5,000.00; Status: Ongoing claim, awaiting settlement.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A Safe, UL listed, Grade 1, with reinforced steel door and dual locking system.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Perimeter fencing, regular security patrols, and surveillance camera system.

3.105
Supermarkets & Grocery Stores
Underwriting Appetite
Our underwriting appetite for supermarkets and grocery stores is
guided by the size, operational complexity, and risk management practices of the business. The
following classifications provide clarity on preferred, acceptable, and non-acceptable risks:
• Preferred:
– Supermarkets with a minimum retail space of 3,000 square feet, demonstrating robust
risk management programs including regular safety audits and documented compliance
with local health and safety regulations.
